fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Mbeki and I live at 343 Alder Close, Madison, WI 53769. You can reach me on (555) 444-2982 or dmitri.mbeki@example.com. On 3 June 2025 the Millbrook River overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2024-00141. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Mbeki on (555) 444-2982 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 3 June 2025.
Site visit to 343 Alder Close. Neighbour Anika Pereira was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dmitri sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
